description: Bornes de recharge parc automobile de l'Etat en Bretagne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Préfecture de région Bretagne. Localisation des bornes de recharge à l'attention du parc de véhicules électriques de l'Etat en Bretagne. Coverage: Préfecture de région Bretagne. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations state car fleet in Brittany" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Préfecture de région Bretagne. Its keywords include vehicule, vehicule-electrique, installations-de-suivi-environnemental, approvisionnement-en-electricite, bretagne, borne. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
